name: Tempester 1.7.0.0 — one Sound read or written by beat and pad over SysEx
summary: Everything in 1.6.9.1; a program can now ask for the Sound of any beat and pad, or send one into any beat and pad, without changing what is selected.

additions: SysEx request 46: the Sound of a given beat (1-16) and pad (1-32), answered in the same format as a Sound dump; the selection on the machine does not change.

SysEx message 47: a Sound sent into a given beat and pad of the project in memory, answered with a short status message (done, or beat or pad out of range). Save the project on the machine to keep it.

description: A feature admitted on the frozen 1.x line by the author's decision of 21/11/2026 (refs/adr/005-1700-indexed-sysex.md, amends ADR 003; public issue #6): 1.6.9.1 with n°74 (patch/indexed_sysex.json: the indexed SysEx commands 0x46-0x4E; request F0 01 28 46 bb pp F7 answers F0 01 28 47 bb pp <the 152-byte body of the 60 message of beat bb, pad pp> F7 without changing the selection or the slot, out of range F0 01 28 4F 46 01 F7), n°75 (patch/indexed_sound_store.json: F0 01 28 47 bb pp <152 bytes> F7 stores that Sound into beat bb, pad pp of the project in RAM, answered F0 01 28 4F 47 00 F7, or 4F 47 01 out of range with nothing written) and its own version digits (patch/version_1.7.0.0.json in place of patch/version_1.6.9.1.json). The image differs from 1.6.9.1 by the words of n°74 and n°75 and the version digits only (tools/line_diff.py --correction), and from the test build 1.7.0.0-a by the version digits only; proved in simulation by tools/sim_indexed_sysex.py with its counter-proofs, and request 43 answers 1.7.0.0 (verify.sh step 2c). Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged. The test build 1.7.0.0-a (the same image with 1.6.9.1's digits) was installed on the author's machine on 21/11/2026 over USB and tried there over USB with the sequencer stopped: 43 answers 1.6.9.1; 46 00 00 = 47 00 00 + byte for byte the body request 40 gives for that slot (the selection); 46 05 09 and 46 0F 1F answer 159 bytes each; 46 10 00 and 46 00 20 answer 4F 46 01; 47 of slot (0,0) onto itself answers 4F 47 00 with the slot unchanged; the Sound of (5,9) stored into (15,31) answers 4F 47 00 and reads back equal; (15,31) restored and read back equal to its original; 47 to beat 16 and to pad 32 answer 4F 47 01; (5,9) and request 40 unchanged afterwards; the author: « pour moi c'est bon ». 1.7.0.0 itself installed on 21/11/2026 by the author from the app's OS update page (its install record holds this image's hashes), machine powered off and on, then tried over USB: 43 answers 1.7.0.0 then 45 with six 0017; 46 05 09 answers 47 05 09 + the same 152 bytes as on 1.7.0.0-a; 46 10 00 answers 4F 46 01; the store round trips of 1.7.0.0-a again (slot onto itself unchanged, (5,9) into (15,31) read back equal then restored equal, beat 16 and pad 32 refused, (5,9) and request 40 unchanged); the same reads and stores with the sequencer playing gave the same bytes, the author: « aucun problème de lecture »; by ear, the author: « à l'oreille c'est bon »; the Sound of beat 6 pad A10 stored into beat 1 pad A1, the selected and shown pad, answered 4F 47 00 (then one Control Change from the machine, not analysed), read back equal, request 40 gave the new Sound, the author: « oui c'est le nouveau son »; Revert Snd tried after that store: the slot still held the stored Sound (the author: « le reverse pas sûr qu'il fonctionne », not investigated), the original then put back with 47 and read back equal. Not tried on the machine: the LEDs after a store into the shown pad (not reported), over DIN.
